title: SearchPlan
description: Orchestrator-derived execution plan. Built from IntentResult before hitting any retrieval index.

retrieval_strategy.description: vector_primary: pgvector leads; keyword_fallback: WC text search only (single-word queries or Gemini timeout); hybrid: both in parallel, vector re-ranks.

pgvector_query.description: Embedding query string — keyword join of the intent's keywords, used to generate the vector sent to pgvector.

provisional_ok.description: If true the caller may render provisional index results before Gemini-ranked results arrive.
